body:
WHAT
When the model Writes a brand-new source file, the engine checks — with no model call — whether similarly named code already exists and whether the model searched or read anything related this session. If similar code exists and no such evidence is on record, a reminder listing the closest matches is attached to the Write's results. The Write itself always runs; the gate never returns an error. Any exception inside the check is swallowed and treated as pass.

WHY
A silent refusal was the root cause of 'it suddenly stops'; the reminder keeps the reuse signal without turning a Write into an unexplained failure.

WHERE
engine/core/src/knowledge/reuseGate.ts — evaluateReuseGate() (the 12-step decision table; returns {kind:'pass'} or {kind:'remind', text}), SearchLog (record(), overlaps()), firmRemindMessage(), remindMessage(), isTestPath(). Wiring: engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — Session.evaluateWriteReuseGate() (structural read of file_path/content, fail-open try/catch), Session.executeToolCalls() (`if (gate.kind === 'remind') this.remind(gate.text)` before permissions.check; the Write still executes), Session.loadSymbolIndex(), tool.searchTerms → searchLog.record.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. ReuseGateResult has only two kinds: with a symbol index containing a very similar symbol and an empty SearchLog, evaluateReuseGate returns kind 'remind' whose text starts with 'Reuse check:' — never a kind that could be mapped to isError.
2. In a Session driven by a FakeProvider that Writes a new .ts file whose stem matches an existing indexed symbol, the tool_result for the Write has isError false/undefined, the file exists on disk afterwards, and the same user message carries a <system-reminder> containing 'Reuse check:'.
3. After searchLog.record(['fooHelper']) the same Write returns pass (step 8) and no reminder is attached.
4. evaluateReuseGate returns pass for an existing file path, a test path (foo.test.ts, tests/x.ts), a non-source extension (.md/.json), a path under node_modules, a path outside cwd, and when cfg.mode is 'off'.
5. When loadIndex throws, evaluateReuseGate returns pass; when the Session wrapper receives input without string file_path/content it returns pass — the Write is never affected.
